title: Lip-Bu Tan Investing $12 Million of His Own Money into Intel Raise: Daniel Newman Calls It a ‘Strong Sign of Confidence’ in Chipmaker’s Future

Intel Corp CEO Lip-Bu Tan is investing $12 million of his own capital in the chipmaker's newly upsized $20 billion stock offering, a move that Futurum Group CEO Daniel Newman sees as a strong vote of confidence.

Lip-Bu Tan Invests $12 Million in Intel Stock Offering

According to a prospectus supplement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission Wednesday, Tan and one family member agreed to purchase a combined $12 million of Intel shares as part of the offering.

Intel priced 210,526,315 shares at $95 each on Tuesday, increasing the offering to $20 billion from the $15 billion announced a day earlier and granting underwriters a 30-day option to purchase an additional 31,578,947 shares.

Newman highlighted Tan's investment on X, writing that "Lip Bu Tan investing $12 million of his own capital into the current $INTC raise should be viewed as a strong sign of confidence in Intel's future."

"I always love to see founders and execs put their own risk capital into deals," Newman added.

Lip Bu Tan investing $12 million of his own capital into the current $INTC raise should be viewed as a strong sign of confidence in Intel's future. I always love to see founders and execs put their own risk capital into deals. Especially ATM. 💪🏻

— Daniel Newman (@danielnewmanUV) August 12, 2026

See Also: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time

Intel's AI Push Gets Fresh Funding

The capital raise comes shortly after Intel reported its strongest revenue growth in years.

Intel's second-quarter revenue reached $16.13 billion, up 25% year over year, while adjusted earnings came in at 42 cents per share, topping Wall Street expectations.

The company forecast third-quarter revenue of $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion and adjusted earnings of 38 cents per share.

Previously, the company cited strong AI data center demand as a key growth driver and increased its 2026 capital spending forecast to $20 billion from $18 billion.

Lip-Bu Tan 在英特尔股票发行中投资 1200 万美元

根据周三向美国证券交易委员会提交的招股说明书补充文件，作为此次发行的一部分，Tan 和一名家族成员同意购买总计 1200 万美元的英特尔股票。

英特尔周二以每股 95 美元的价格发行了 210,526,315 股股票，将发行规模从前一天宣布的 150 亿美元增加到 200 亿美元，并授予承销商 30 天的选择权，可额外购买 31,578,947 股。

英特尔的人工智能推动获得新的资金

此次融资是在英特尔公布多年来最强劲的收入增长后不久进行的。

英特尔第二季度营收达到161.3亿美元，同比增长25%，调整后每股收益42美分，超出华尔街预期。

该公司预计第三季度营收为 158 亿美元至 168 亿美元，调整后每股收益为 38 美分。

此前，该公司将强劲的人工智能数据中心需求视为关键增长动力，并将 2026 年资本支出预测从 180 亿美元上调至 200 亿美元。
